title: io Design System — API Surface Snapshot
description: Machine-generated public API baseline produced by scripts/snapshot-api-surface.cjs. Used by scripts/check-api-surface.cjs to detect breaking changes across PRs.

generated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of when this snapshot was generated.

components.description: Map of component tag names (e.g. 'io-button') to their public API definition.

props.description: Map of prop name to TypeScript type string.

methods.description: Map of public method name to signature string.

events.description: Map of event name to CustomEvent detail type string.
